title: F-Term Hybrid Inflation with T-Model Kähler Geometry and Beyond
summary: We analyze F-term hybrid inflation (FHI) within various grand unified theories (GUTs) in the presence of a Kähler potential for the inflaton field which parameterizes the Kähler manifolds $SU(1,1)/U(1)$ or $SU(2)/U(1)$. We take into account supergravity, radiative, and soft supersymmetry-breaking corrections to the tree-level potential and find that viable FHI can be realized without extrema along the inflationary trajectory for a broad region of the parameter space.
